title: Any WiFi client can send HTTP DELETE to /meeting-recording/delete to permanently delete files… (CVE-2026-128791)
description: CVE-2026-128791 is a critical vulnerability allowing any WiFi client to send an unauthenticated HTTP DELETE request to the /meeting-recording/delete endpoint, resulting in permanent deletion of files. This flaw requires no authentication or privileges, making it highly exploitable in affected systems.
